name: Hunta-H
source:
When Se-ra, a normal part-timer finds a crumpled piece of forum spam containing something akin to a cry for help, she leaves a well-meant reply, leading her on a path of a strange sort of 'friendship'.
Meanwhile, surprise surprise, she's also roped into a job as an errand runner for the company that manages Hunta-H one of the up and coming Korean Pop groups of the year...

Play as Se-ra as she warms up to said friendship whilst at the same time navigating her hectic work schedule... This isn't really easy since she has to deal with unreasonable tantrums and the difficulties/drama that comes along with an idol's fame. And really, just idols in general... Because goodness, they're such a handful.

[From [url=https://sayumi101.itch.io/hunta-h]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当世拉，一个普通的兼职者，发现了一张皱巴巴的论坛垃圾邮件，其中包含类似于呼救的内容时，她留下了善意的回复，引导她走上了一条奇怪的“友谊”之路。
与此同时，令人惊讶的是，她还找到了一份跑腿的工作，该公司管理着年度新兴韩国流行乐队之一的Hunta-H……

扮演世拉，一边热身于友谊，一边应对繁忙的工作安排……这并不容易，因为她必须应对无理的发脾气以及偶像成名带来的困难/戏剧性问题。事实上，只是一般的偶像……因为天哪，他们太少了。

[来自[url=https://sayumi101.itch.io/hunta-h]Itch.io[/url]]
